summary: Golub Capital BDC, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding entry into an underwriting agreement for a public offering of $500 million aggregate principal amount of 6.250% Notes due 2031. The offering is conducted under an existing shelf registration statement, with closing expected May 27, 2026. This is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation. No material corporate change, premium, or strategic event is involved; the filing merely discloses a financing transaction. No further action or risk-arb angle is warranted.
